verdict.rationale: Pigment documents that agent (MCP) sessions are authenticated through enterprise identity, with access scoped by role, model, or metric, and that admins approve which assistants can connect. This gives agents least-privilege access, but through identity-based sessions rather than issuable, agent-specific API credentials. Missing for 10: documented issuance of scoped API keys/tokens for agents, per-credential permission scopes, credential rotation/revocation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
